items.title: File Einspruch against the tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielguestrow eingehen, schriftlich, ueber das Portal ELSTER oder muendlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 2026-11-18, sent by post. Per Section 122(2)(1) AO a mailed notice is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: 18.11.2026 + 4 days = 22.11.2026, a Sunday. Since this fictional delivery day is a Sunday, Bekanntgabe shifts to the next business day, Monday 2026-11-23. Under Section 108(1) AO with Section 187(1) BGB the day of Bekanntgabe is excluded from counting; under Section 188(2) BGB a one-month period ends on the day of the following month with the same number as the triggering day, giving 2026-12-23. That date is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, so it stands as the final day.
